---
title: "Projects"
page-layout: full
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(readr)
library(htmltools)

projects <- read_csv("data/projects.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

make_row <- function(row) {
  tags$article(
    class = "catalog-card",
    tags$div(
      class = "catalog-main",
      tags$div(
        tags$p(class = "project-id", row$project_id),
        tags$h2(row$title),
        tags$p(class = "catalog-desc", row$description)
      ),
      tags$span(class = paste("status-badge", tolower(gsub(" ", "-", row$status))), row$status)
    ),
    tags$div(
      class = "detail-grid",
      tags$div(class = "detail-box", tags$span("Peers"), tags$p(row$peers)),
      tags$div(class = "detail-box", tags$span("Topics"), tags$p(row$topics)),
      tags$div(class = "detail-box", tags$span("Papers"), tags$p(row$paper_titles)),
      tags$div(class = "detail-box", tags$span("Code keywords"), tags$p(row$code_keywords))
    ),
    tags$div(
      class = "resource-row",
      tags$a(class = "resource-pill strong", href = row$project_page, "Open overview"),
      tags$a(class = "resource-pill", href = row$peers_md, "Peers"),
      tags$a(class = "resource-pill", href = row$papers_md, "Papers"),
      tags$a(class = "resource-pill", href = row$code_md, "Code"),
      tags$a(class = "resource-pill", href = row$videos_md, "Videos")
    )
  )
}

tagList(
  tags$section(
    class = "page-hero",
    tags$div(
      class = "hero-inner",
      tags$p(class = "hero-kicker", "Project catalog"),
      tags$h1("All projects"),
      tags$p(class = "hero-subtitle", "A fuller project directory with quick links to collaborators, papers, code, and videos.")
    )
  ),
  tags$main(
    class = "site-main normal-top",
    tags$section(
      class = "catalog-list",
      lapply(seq_len(nrow(projects)), function(i) make_row(projects[i, ]))
    )
  )
)
```
